summary: A one-page site for a fictional Gulf Coast and Southern kitchen in Houston Heights, built so a hungry customer on a phone can read the menu, check today's hours and call or get directions in one tap.
highlights: Full menu written as real text with prices and dietary markers, not a photo or PDF
Shows whether the kitchen is open today and highlights today in the weekly hours
Call and Directions buttons stay pinned at the top of every screen
Map, parking note and a private events and catering inquiry that opens an email
